title: Team statement that limestone absorbs the signal from the known Khafre chambers
summary: Jeffrey tells of Team statement that limestone absorbs the signal from the known Khafre chambers, about 2025 at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: This is because the structures are embedded in a limestone slab that absorbs the signal.

plain: A man named Jeffrey, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, relays a 2025 statement posted on Facebook by a research team, including men named Armando and Filippo, who scanned the Khafre pyramid at Giza in Egypt. According to the statement, the pyramid's already known chambers do not show up clearly in their scans because they sit in a limestone slab that absorbs the signal. It matters to the story because the team says their scans reveal hidden structures beneath the pyramids, and this explains why some known rooms look different.
